mods.name: Twist Space Technology
mods.note: Reset GregTech.lang and TwistSpaceTechnology.cfg on update. 0.8.1 crashes world start on 2.9.0 (Bottled Chaos, thionyl chloride); skip it, see mods.md.

mods.name: 123Technology
mods.note: Releases before 2.2.1 crash on 2.9.0 stable, and 2.2.1 skips recipes with Twist loaded; its overpowered recipes are off in config-tweaks.md.

mods.name: EZStorage
mods.note: scripts/simplestorage_gregified.zs names its ids; recheck them on a bump.

mods.name: Realistic World Gen 2
mods.note: Replaces the pack's 2.0.6. Biome Size Multiplier 1.7 in rwg2.cfg; continental settings only apply to new worlds.

mods.name: Angelica
mods.note: Pack ships 2.2.43; 2.2.45 installed 2026-11-08. Update for a fix you need (Angelica#2092, Vulkan flicker), then test ChromaPatch and shaders, Distant Horizons and Xaero's maps.

mods.name: Xaero's World Map
mods.note: Open Angelica#2092: crash with a lava-retexturing pack (Modernity) and the Witching Gadgets Thaumic Stone Extruder on screen.

mods.name: OmniOcular Unofficial
mods.note: Client uses the full jar; the server uses OmniOcularUnofficial-<version>-server.jar. 1.7.x can pull GTNH config; back up config/OmniOcular/ before a bump.

mods.name: GTNH Planner
mods.note: Betas, though GitHub marks them stable. Plans live in gtnhplanner/plans.dat; back it up before a bump.

mods.name: Neo ECO AE Extension
mods.note: On trial. GitHub is the official 1.7.10 repo; Modrinth lags it. Back up the world first; see mods.md.

mods.name: Distant Horizons
mods.note: Client and server run the same jar; config is in mods.md.

mods.name: ChromaPatch
mods.note: A bump can rebuild the patched Eclipse pack; then rebuild Warpledge Edit with eclipse-warpledge-edit/build.py (shaders.md).

mods.name: Eclipse Shader
mods.note: Pinned to the commit ChromaPatch targets; newer commits may fail to patch, and a move means rebuilding the patched pack. See shaders.md.

mods.name: Kura packs and config
mods.note: KuraNeon, KuraReflections, KuraBetterCoils, KuraNeonExtras and KuramA's Eclipse config, taken from main. A new config overwrites your own settings.

mods.name: Euphoria Patcher
mods.note: Only the NeonTech fallback uses it, not the active Eclipse setup. Pinned to match NeonTech; a bump means copying the NeonTech values by hand.

mods.name: AE2Things

mods.name: LagGoggles
